The {{PAGENAME}} lies on the road between [[Sweet Home|Home]] and [[Village|The Village]]. The [[Miller]] is located north of the farm, while the [[Farmer]] and his [[Farmer's Son|Son]] are located south.

There is a grave under the tree in the North-West field that can be exhumed.
